snippet.title: Tome of Ruin: The Word Dungeon – Official Trailer | Wishlist on Steam
snippet.description:
A dark fantasy RPG where your words are your weapons.
Collect over 1,000 illustrated words in your Lexicon, enchant your gear, enter the Arena and face the bosses of 8 dungeons.

Play with words in English, Spanish, Portuguese, French or German.
Coming to Steam on December 7, 2026. The free demo is out now on Steam.

Play the free demo and wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5559550/Tome_of_Ruin_The_Word_Dungeon/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=demo2026
Website: https://castledarkmoor.com

#TomeOfRuin #RPG #DarkFantasy #PCGaming
